_comment: SINGLE-BATCH PORTABILITY campaign for 05_full_matrix.sh. ONE formal execution matrix: the UNION of four heterogeneous rectangular blocks (the logical fragments formerly split across matrix.portability.m1..m4.json). Different workloads carry different target-strategy sets and seed semantics, so the campaign is expressed as explicit blocks -- NOT a global Cartesian product (which would fabricate scientifically unintended workload x strategy cells). The union recomputes to EXACTLY 234 baseline-target pairs / 468 formal invocations under ONE portability_run_config_sha256 (64f44c3e..., independent of the byte-frozen primary 022fbeb0... and secondary 441609e6... YC campaigns), ONE schedule_seed (20260826), and ONE campaign fingerprint over the complete ordered 468-invocation schedule. baseline is the paired A-arm anchor in every block (not a target). Deployment/feasibility + footprint evidence only; warm paired first-query latency is NOT a strategy-performance estimate (page-cache carryover falsified; positional/order effect). Every block field is validated against the frozen runtime artifact pin before anything runs; real invocation still requires WS2_MATRIX_IMPL_READY=1. Run this ONE matrix once: 05_full_matrix.sh --matrix ./matrix.portability.json. The m1..m4 files remain only as readable logical fragments; they are NOT units of formal execution.
